# Pricing

> How a price is set and tested: willingness to pay and its measurement, price discrimination and personalised pricing with their law and ethics, anchors and reference prices, and a program that estimates willingness to pay from survey data. First review written: willingness-to-pay measurement, ending on the baseline B1.

Each page's markdown source is served at the same path with a .md extension. This index is written by hand; AGENTS.md says to keep it in step.

## The repository

- [Pricing](https://tewf.github.io/business-pricing/README.md): the scope, what the first review found, the baseline B1 and the questions it answered
- [Evidence](https://tewf.github.io/business-pricing/evidence/README.md): the first review, on willingness to pay, with the bibliography
- [Willingness to pay](https://tewf.github.io/business-pricing/evidence/willingness-to-pay/README.md): 39 sources in five steps, with the claims table and the named baseline
- [Baseline](https://tewf.github.io/business-pricing/evidence/willingness-to-pay/baseline.md): B1, a stated range checked against a paid measure on the same good
- [Bibliography](https://tewf.github.io/business-pricing/evidence/bibliography.md): every work cited, once
- [Decisions](https://tewf.github.io/business-pricing/decisions/README.md): one record per choice that shapes the repository

## Contributing

- [Contributing](https://tewf.github.io/business-pricing/AGENTS.md): rules for changing this repository
- [Standard](https://tewf.github.io/reader-ergonomics/standard.md): the reader-ergonomics card this repository obeys
